name: Advent
source:
Your sister is sick. Can you help her recover by giving her the best Christmas ever?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20221226205227/https://13dev.itch.io/advent]Itch.io[/url]]

Adapted from a simulation game with the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20221226205234/https://13dev.itch.io/0812-advent]same name[/url].
translation:
你的妹妹生病了。你能給她一個有史以來最棒的聖誕節，幫她康復嗎？

[引自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20221226205227/https://13dev.itch.io/advent]Itch.io[/url]]

改編自一款[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20221226205234/https://13dev.itch.io/0812-advent]同名[/url]模擬遊戲。
